suite.command: flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter test

setup.command: flutter pub get && dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs

surfaces.name: Voice recorder
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill): a debug or profile build of the worktree installed in a lab instance, one platform at a time with Windows first, driven through its Dart VM service with the smoke entry point's ext.smoke.* extensions (copy ~/.mitosis/field-notes/voice-and-day-panel/smoke-macos/lib/main_smoke.dart into the build copy and build with -t lib/main_smoke.dart); SMOKE_FAKE_MIC=1 streams recorded speech where the guest has no microphone

surfaces.name: Video recorder
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill) as for the voice recorder; only the Android emulator has a camera, the macOS and Windows guests do not

surfaces.name: Voice and video playback on cards and in the log viewer
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill) with the smoke entry point; seed media through ext.smoke.seed; the guests have no sound device, so audible output and output routing are not observable there

surfaces.name: Past-day pop-up and Android day sheet
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill) with the smoke entry point: Calendar, a seeded day, its pop-up or sheet, cards, right-column pane, full screen and day arrows

surfaces.name: Settings, Voice section (input and output)
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill) with the smoke entry point: Settings, Voice; input meter, input and output dropdowns, output volume

surfaces.name: Today screen and text notes
surfaces.driver: flutter_test widget tests on the real widget tree, then the VM lab with a debug build driven through its Dart VM service

surfaces.name: Garden and Meadow
surfaces.driver: VM lab (lab skill) with meadowKeyProvider pinned for comparable screenshots; GPU timing needs the real Note 10+, which only the owner grants

surfaces.name: Search, reminders, onboarding, data export and updates
surfaces.driver: flutter_test widget tests on the real widget tree, then the VM lab with a debug build driven through its Dart VM service

surfaces.name: Device sync relay
surfaces.driver: the server's own tests under server/test; the production relay is never driven

lab_platforms.value: macos, windows, android-phone, android-tablet, ipad (lab status 2026-10-18)
lab_platforms.recheck: lab status and the vm-lab skill

lab_guest_devices.value: macOS guest: Apple Virtual Sound Device output only, no microphone, no camera (system_profiler 2026-10-18)
lab_guest_devices.recheck: Get-PnpDevice in the Windows guest; system_profiler in the macOS guest

windows_build_machine.value: winpc (owner's Windows 11 PC over SSH, build-only; app tests run in the VM lab)

vm_service_port.recheck: start a build with those switches and connect to ws://127.0.0.1:47300/ws

off_limits: Running a test build, or flutter drive, on the owner's phones
Running test builds on the owner's Windows PC unless the owner says so in that session
Playing sound through this Mac's speakers, or on the owner's PC while the owner is on a call
Deploying to or writing to the production sync relay
Touching the installed Field Notes app or its data on this Mac or the owner's PC
Releasing lab instances with lab down --all
test_data: No backend. A fresh install starts empty; seeded installs and integration_test/fixtures supply realistic journals and media, and the smoke entry point seeds through ext.smoke.seed; all test data is disposable.
